1593cc24-e67a-411e-8e30-eec88a5ee670.description:
A mysterious man suddenly appears in the desert separating the East and West Continents. A young boy, Yulian Provoke from the Pareia tribe finds this man, and brings him to his village. 49d64db2-5841-4ccc-aee8-7b3a0970f6df.title: I'm Being Raised by Villains
49d64db2-5841-4ccc-aee8-7b3a0970f6df.description:
I thought I was an illegitimate child… but it turns out that I was a complete stranger?!

A year after transmigrating as an extra, I found out that I was on the verge of being kicked out.

I said I’d rather leave the house on my own.

“Actually, this child is my daughter. Right, daughter?”

Did I catch the attention of the psychopathic duke?

‘I heard that the money he gave after playing with someone was enough to buy an island?’

I got along with him as his daughter because I thought I could get his fortune later on. And a few months later, I would leave his house with a thick bank account.

“Stay by my side until I tell you to leave.”

However, my dad, who regarded me as a toy, came looking for me and held me back.

=

After returning home due to dad’s persuasion, the families and my dad fought to adopt me. My uncles and aunts gathered to protect me, and future psychos began to have strange obsessions over me.

“Happy Birthday, Ayrin. You’re the head as of today.”

On top of that, the duke’s position was my birthday present.
Everything is going just as I expected.

[Hey, how long are you going to sleep? Grandma said she is gonna take you off life support!]
[Cha Miso, you’re going to die!]

What is that voice?
Will I be okay like this? (Synopsis: Gourmet Scans)

b106762c-0302-4098-825e-d2e4d73bd87e.title: Moto Tansakusha no Ojii-chan: Mago ni Segamarete Dungeon Haishin o Hajimeta njaga, Nazeka Bazuriotta wai
b106762c-0302-4098-825e-d2e4d73bd87e.altTitle: A Former Explorer and Grandpa: I Started Streaming at the Request of My Granddaughter, but Why Did I End up Chasing the Buzz?!
b106762c-0302-4098-825e-d2e4d73bd87e.description:
Many years have passed since “dungeons” began to exist in the world. “Grandpa, stream a dungeon run for us! You used to be an explorer, right?” Urged by his grandchild, former dungeon explorer Genji Kudō decides to dive into a dungeon for the first time in 30 years. But Genji’s dungeon strategies, shaped by the old ways rather than modern conventions, start to pile up unexpected results—until his adventures go viral and cause a sensation across the nation…?!
___
**Original Web Novel:** [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/16817330661917481482), [Syosetu](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n2708ik/)

bcfa196d-d162-45f5-a224-61d26b04a077.description: Kazuma Sato is a video game-loving shut-in-or at least he was, until a humiliating traffic accident brings his young life to an untimely end. But after his death, a beautiful girl claiming to be a goddess invites him to enter another world and gain some respectable perks in the process. But Kazuma's choice is going to have serious consequences for the goddess and the dead man alike...

00cbb62b-b002-464d-bda7-8e650338417e.title: World Extinction War
00cbb62b-b002-464d-bda7-8e650338417e.description:
Heavenly Demons, Hunters, Giant Robots, Demon Kings, and Superhumans.

The strongest warriors from countless worlds gather in one place, with the survival of their respective worlds at stake.

In this battle for survival, where defeat means nothing less than the destruction of an entire world, the representatives of the “Ordinary World”—the only ones with no special powers whatsoever—are dragged into the conflict.

Just as they are about to be crushed by the overwhelming strength of monsters who exist far beyond normal standards, they are given an unexpected weapon.

[The abilities of your game character are being synchronized]

Can Shin Jahyeon and the representatives of the Ordinary World borrow the powers of their game characters, defeat the true strongest beings, and survive?

af0527c1-8734-4498-b128-7090340bc10d.title: Dragon Ball (Official Colored)
af0527c1-8734-4498-b128-7090340bc10d.description: Goku and friends battle intergalactic evil in the greatest action-adventure-fantasy-comedy-fighting series ever! Legend has it that if all seven of the precious orbs called “Dragon Balls” are gathered together, an incredibly powerful dragon god will appear to grant one wish. Unfortunately, the orbs are scattered across the world, making them extremely difficult to collect. Enter 16-year-old Bulma, a scientific genius who has constructed a radar to detect the exact locations of the Dragon Balls. She’s on a mission to find all seven orbs, but first she must convince young Son Goku to join her on her quest. With a monkey tail, superhuman strength and a magic staff for a weapon, Son Goku is ready to set out on the adventure of a lifetime…

8329fabe-41d2-4c63-8d06-41400185dcbc.title: Area 88
8329fabe-41d2-4c63-8d06-41400185dcbc.description: The story is about a young pilot named Shin Kazama and his experiences at Area 88, a mercenary air force base secluded in the desert of a war torn country. Shin goes from head of his class at a world renowned aviation school dating the beautiful daughter of an airline president to a mercenary fighter pilot bound to Area 88 by a three-year contract that he was duped into signing by a jealous and competitive childhood friend. Determined to earn $1.5 million dollars to buy his way out of the obligation and return home, killing becomes second nature to Shin as he quickly rises to the top rank at Area 88. Overwrought with shame and self-loathing for what he has become, Shin begins to question whether he is still fighting for survival, or like his fellow mercenaries, for the sheer excitement and camaraderie of battle.

9bc96d35-29f4-4c91-9f8d-069267fb7aa9.description:
In the land of the cat people, it is a serious crime for outsiders to enter without permission. However, Nene, a mouse-girl, has managed to sneak into the country with a mysterious goal. In the meantime, Nene finds work at the Rai Rai Teahouse. Working alongside beautiful cat-girls, she struggles to learn how to "be a cat" from her senpais.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

0d878b98-7bc4-4fde-8448-cc03afaed32f.title: Myoryeong ui Hwangja
0d878b98-7bc4-4fde-8448-cc03afaed32f.description: An immortal emperor rules the Kingdom of Yeol, a divine country blessed by gods with awesome powers. After a thousand years of peaceful rule, the time has come for a new emperor to be chosen. This is determined by a series of trials, in which twenty princes with special powers who have trained since birth must compete. As all princes of varying personalities and agendas gather to partake in the trials, intrigue and possibly even bloodshed seem all but certain. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the other princes, the Fourth Prince Jeok-yeon Ryu hides a secret he must guard with his life.

e57b1be2-006d-47aa-99b9-cd08fb6284ea.description:
"I want to sleep with you."
"... What?"
"I want to do it with Sung Ji-Won."

The day I turned 20. I spent the night with you, trying to make a memory. That's how we met again after 10 years, Joo Sung-Hyun, still handsome...

"Interest-free loan, limit is up to you, you don't have to pay it back."
"... What?"
"Keep going, acting like a live-in girlfriend."

You still threw the wrong fastball, and I caught it. Joo Sung-Hyun, what are your true feelings?

3f0abf80-7ee1-44c3-9178-d5040d028f48.description: The human army lost the battle against the vampires on Higanjima Island. Unable to prevent Miyabi's plan, Japan has become a vampire country.
